mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that triggers Federal Reserve policy accommodation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strengthening that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During housing recovery (HOUST > 700,000 units), rising consumer spending (RSAFS growth) signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 700 and RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 95) indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it triggers monetary policy tightening expectations that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 1.5%) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls growth exceeds 150,000 jobs per month, it signals a robust labor market that increases consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150 (150,000 jobs).
